description: This file defines the main Home page component of a Lightning.js-based notes application. It includes a template with UI layout, state management, computed properties, lifecycle hooks, and methods for handling note operations (create, edit, delete, save, filter, sort) and user interactions via keyboard events.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main Lightning component representing the home page with notes list and editor sidebar. Handles user interactions, editing, filtering, sorting, and note management.

methods.name: $formatTime
methods.description: Formats timestamp into a human-readable string with date and time.

methods.name: $makeNote
methods.description: Creates a new note object with a unique id, title, content, and timestamp.

methods.name: $selectById
methods.description: Selects a note by id and loads it into the draft for viewing or editing.

methods.name: $newNote
methods.description: Sets mode to create a new note and initializes draft.

methods.name: $editSelected
methods.description: Enters edit mode for the currently selected note.

methods.name: $saveDraft
methods.description: Validates and saves the current draft, either creating or updating a note.

methods.name: $deleteSelected
methods.description: Deletes the selected note with toast notification and undo option.

methods.name: $undoDelete
methods.description: Restores the last deleted note if within the undo window.

methods.name: $cycleSort
methods.description: Toggles sorting order of the notes list.

methods.name: $moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the current selection up or down within filtered notes.

methods.name: $typeIn
methods.description: Adds characters to specified input fields (search, title, content).

methods.name: $backspace
methods.description: Removes last character from specified input fields.
